                break
            for val in row:
                if val not in (0, 1):
                    is_matrix = False
                    break
            if not is_matrix:
                break

    if is_matrix:
        neighbors = [set(j for j in range(n) if adj[i][j] == 1) for i in range(n)]
    else:

    # Ensure symmetry (undirected)

            if u not in neighbors[v]:
                neighbors[v].add(u)
